title: Amazing Experience
text:
Learned a lot about Sitges as well as Spain.. Leonardo was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions . He spoke very good English which we were very appreciative of.
And of course we took some very amazing pictures.
author: raymondjW5461YN

title: Great way to ‘focus’ on the city!
text: David was very knowledgeable about both history and vantage points from where to take pictures.  Even taught us a few tricks to bring out the art of the shot and not just  the subject.  Great way to see and become more intimate with Sitges!
author: jeromesU8167KO

title: 12/10 amazing tour. Don’t miss it, it’s amazing!
text: We had the best time in Sitges. Our guide Leonardo showed us the most beautiful hidden corners, explained us so many interesting things and we learned how to take amazing photos. What you get for your money is incredible. I really recommend the tour to anyone photographer or not who wants to have an amazing and really authentic and memorable experience in Sitges. Leonardo is a really lovely person so spending two hours exploring with him is such a treat. You will not regret taking this tour I promise.
author: F4777AAcharlottew

title: Puddles, reflections and mirrors. Amazing tour
text: Charlotte was incredible, so knowledgeable on the area and its history but also with an amazing imagination to get unique and unusual photos. We had an amazing time and would recommend this tour to anyone
author: Darren_Smith76

title: Lovely informative experience in which we gained some really helpful practical skills
text: This was our first time in Sitges and Charlotte & Leo were fantastic. Whilst showing us some very useful practical tips to help with our photography, they also gave us an informative tour of the beautiful town. We had our 14 year old son with us and even he found it interesting and helpful (every photo now uses long exposure on his iPhone!). Can’t recommend Leo & Charlotte highly enough, interesting, helpful and fun.
author: cdkingaby

title: Really useful and fun
text: We found out so much about the capabilities we have in our phone and fun ways to use them.   We want to do it again...
author: Fiona_B

title: Highly recommend this photo tour!
text: Chatlotte was an amazing guide. She showed us lots of tricks to use with our mobile phone cameras, had interesting stories about the city and the architecture, and gave us an overall wonderful experience. We took some great photos and kept trying the tricks she taught us on the rest of our trip. Highly recommend!!
author: Leslie P

title: THE BEST WAY TO LEARN ABOUT THE HISTORY OF SITGES
text: If you want to discover Sitges, this experience is definitely ideal to do with friends or family! A fun way to get to know the history of Sitges, its most emblematic places and corners that would go unnoticed! Plus, you learn to take advantage of your mobile phone to take quality photos, useful for everyday life. Guide Leonardo made the route super interesting. I recommend it 100%!!! Hopefully this business will grow and many more that support local culture and history!!
author: Judss03

title: (Re)discovering Sitges
text:
Yesterday with my two friends we did the Photo Tour of Sitges and it was a fantastic experience. The tour was very interesting and we discovered many details and curiosities that people who frequent Sitges do not usually know. 

Our guide, Leonardo, was excellent: he explained everything very clearly and passionately, providing little known data that made the tour even more special. In addition, he taught us very useful photography techniques, easily applicable even with our own mobiles, which made the experience also fun and useful for the future.

author: camillafranchinii

title: Highly recommended photography tour
text: Leo was an amazing tour guide. He made everyone feel very comfortable and wonderful stories and really understood the history of location. He took us to a lot of fun hidden gems and was very patient teaching us how to take very cool angles for our photographs. Sitges is beautiful but Leo made it even more so! Highly recommended it sounds like his tour company does tours and lots of different cities and would definitely take them again. A great mix of photography history and lovely stories.
